row.notes: myteam-g2: Applies the My Team team identity from the setup record to the game entrants: gets the setup data (vtbl+0x1c8 on setup+0x270), finds the player team entry, calls Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceTeam(entrants,team_key,&newTeam) and Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceVehicle(entrants,vehicle_key,&newVehicle), updates FUN_140c2e220/140c2c5f0 (livery/colours) and finally Career_OwnerSetup_ApplySuit. Hook: this is where the chosen team name, colours and car replace the stock entrant.

verify.notes: V9024 Setup data via vtbl+0x1c8 on setup+0x270, Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceTeam (about line 714) and ReplaceVehicle (about line 1011), FUN_140c2e220 and FUN_140c2c5f0, and Career_OwnerSetup_ApplySuit (141401dd0) at the end are all present.
